title: ReactiveConf 2017 - Tom Dale: Secrets of the Glimmer VM
summary: Tom Dale explains the internals of the Glimmer VM, Ember's rendering engine, which compiles templates to opcodes. The talk includes a performance benchmark demo.
why: HN points to it for understanding Glimmer and Ember's view layer, and as a reference for opcode-compiled templates.

quote.text: you should not miss @tomdale's talk at ReactConf about GlimmerJS
